name: surge_freezes_stipend
description: The Surge (design 1.4): both Holdfasts standing after wave 12, waves 9 to 11 come again. Seat 1 uncorks the Moth Cloud in wave 2 for a stipend of 4; the hollows are set to wave 12 during wave 2 (a logged scenario setter), so when it clears the Surge's first window opens: EV_SURGE (surge 1, repeating wave 9, before wave 13), a window of 480 ticks for both, the stipend paid at the clear. A cork there costs half of tier III's 85 (42), and its uncorking adds nothing to the stipend, which stays 4 and is still paid at the next clear. The Surge's wave has wave 9's creeps with 1.35 times wave 9's health: a Scuttler 16 x 3 x 1.35 = 64.8.

steps.msg: the uncorking outside the Surge added tier I's 4
the Surge's first window, repeating wave 9, with its Drift
a short window of 8 s for both
the stipend was paid at seat 1's clear
a Surge cork costs half of tier III's price
